Booking cutoff three days before at 21:00 (October 14); currently online booking is unavailable and first-come bookings can be refused even after online success. No cancellation for rain. Pay before service. Building entry restrictions begin 14:30 and entrances progressively close, so arrive early. Explicitly not treated as eligible for organizer coupon. Published drink categories: Asahi draft/nonalcoholic and Asian bottled beers, Kaku highballs, GINON sours, cocktails, selected red/white/rosé/sparkling wine (bottles allowed), shochu, soft drinks; unspecified individual labels not invented.

specials.title: Free organizer with six-person course booking
specials.description: One organizer dines free with a reserved party of at least six on one of four eligible Asian/Hawaiian courses, normally ¥4,500 or ¥5,500 per person including tax.
conditions: Request and present the coupon at reservation; course booking required.
Minimum six guests; one coupon once per group; cannot combine other vouchers or services.
Specific eligible courses: Asian casual/premium and Hawaiian casual/premium; seat-only, ordinary à la carte and fireworks Hana course excluded.
Restaurant service hours are 11:00–23:00; actual reserved course start is subject to booking availability, seating two hours, course booking normally closes same-day 19:00.
Coupon has no published expiry and must still be live on Hot Pepper when used; screenshots/printouts do not preserve withdrawn terms.
Course headings say ninety-minute free-flow while description says two hours; confirm final duration with venue. Do not assume normal à la carte drinks are included.
